{{Quote|I wish he wouldn't shoot paying customers.|The bartender, on Kyle Katarn, after the latter killed Shmorg and his partners|audio=BaronsHedBartender-PayingCustomers.flac|<ref name="DF2" />}}
A '''tavern''' existed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Barons Hed]], it stood at the edge of the [[Barons Hed Lagoon]] and employed a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]]. The [[Cantina/Legends|establishment]] once hosted five members of the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who, after ordering drinks, could not decide who was going to pay the bill, which erupted into a [[Unarmed combat/Legends|brawl]]. After two of the Gran fell [[Death/Legends|dead]], the fledgling [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]] entered the establishment and killed the remaining Gran.

==Description==
A [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]] was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Barons Hed]], built right at the edge of the [[Barons Hed Lagoon]]. Staffed by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Barons Hed bartender|bartender]], the tavern was a stomping ground for city residents in need of a refreshment. From the outside, the building appeared as a [[Color/Legends|gray]], mostly featureless structure, with three horizontal grooves and a rectangular [[Window/Legends|window]] above a rectangular door. The door's lining was bronze in color and had several glyphs carved into it. The tavern was actually part of a building block that also included a set of apartments and the [[House of Max]]. The upper levels of the apartments could be reached via a staircase that led to a balcony patio built atop the tavern.<ref name="DF2" />

The tavern's interior was spartan, containing no furniture other than a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] bar that extended from one wall and stopped short of the opposite wall. Behind the bar was an alcove with a decorative pattern that carried three [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal shield charges]]. The walls were stone-gray, and the floor was tiled. The ceiling was also gray and had support beams that ran the length of the cantina.<ref name="DF2" />

==History==
{{Quote|No, Shmorg, I've got it.|A Gran offers to buy drinks|<ref name="DFG">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Shmorg_and_Friends.png|thumb|right|250px|The tavern's interior, inhabited by Gran]]
The tavern had been built<ref name="DF2" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> when Barons Hed had become a haven for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in the employ of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At one point, five [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters entered the tavern for drinks.<ref name="DF2" /> When one of them, [[Shmorg]], offered to pay the bill, [[Unidentified Gran (Barons Hed)|another Gran]] offered to buy the drinks instead. An argument erupted,<ref name="DFG" /> and the Gran started a violent [[Unarmed combat/Legends|brawl]]. As it broke out, the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] tried to dissuade the use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="DF2" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II}}
After two of the Gran were killed in the confrontation,<ref name="DFG" /> the brawl was put to an end by [[Kyle Katarn]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi training/Legends|trainee]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] all of the remaining Gran when they tried to attack him. Katarn took the tavern's supply of shield units before leaving.<ref name="DF2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In any case, if Gran are stupid enough to kill each other, be smart enough to let them.|Rick Barba, ''Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide''|<ref name="DFG" />}}
The tavern appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' as a location in the game's fifth level. The tavern encounter is optional and can be skipped without any ill-effect.<ref name="DF2" /> If the player visits the tavern, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide]]'' author [[Rick Barba]] suggests waiting for the Gran to kill two of their own before engaging the survivors and pillaging the tavern for supplies.<ref name="DFG" />
